title: Laredo's Five Playoff Teams All Fall in the Bi-District Round
excerpt: All five of Laredo's playoff teams lost their bi-district games: United, LBJ, Alexander, Nixon and Cigarroa are out after the opening round.
content:
All five of Laredo's high school football playoff teams saw their seasons end in the bi-district round, with losses on Friday and Saturday, Nov. 13-14, according to statewide playoff scores.

In Class 6A Division I, San Antonio Harlan beat Laredo United 48-14 on Friday, and San Antonio Brennan beat Laredo LBJ 66-14. United had claimed the District 30-6A title outright during the regular season.

In Class 6A Division II, San Antonio Warren beat Laredo Alexander 43-18 on Saturday afternoon at the United ISD Student Activity Center, according to MaxPreps.

In Class 5A Division I, Smithson Valley beat Laredo Nixon 77-15. In Class 5A Division II, Corpus Christi Ray beat Laredo Cigarroa 42-14. Cigarroa had reached the playoffs for the first time in 20 years.

Five of Laredo's eight high school teams had made the playoffs this year. All five are now out after the opening round.

Sources:

  • High School Football America: Final scores from the opening round of the 2026 UIL Texas high school football playoffs
  • MaxPreps: Laredo High School Football Scores
